summary.name: XGetter
summary.one_liner: XGetter is a media downloader for saving video and audio from many major websites, with options to cut clips and download subtitles.
use_cases: Download videos from YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram
Save audio tracks from online videos
Download an entire YouTube channel or playlist
Remove intro or outro by cutting a clip
Download subtitles uploaded by authors or auto-generated
summary.what_it_does: XGetter downloads video and audio from 40+ platforms, including YouTube, TikTok, Bilibili, Instagram, DailyMotion, Weibo and TED. It can cut a video or audio file to keep only the needed part, such as removing an intro or outro. It can also download subtitles that are uploaded by the author or automatically generated, with subtitle support listed for YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, Bilibili and DailyMotion, and Youku marked as coming soon. The free tier supports up to 2K video and audio download, while paid licenses add 8K, private video, channel/playlist/account download, subtitle download and cropping.
notable: Downloads whole channels, playlists and accounts (paid tiers)
Cut video/audio to remove intro or outro
Listed in awesome-mac under Download Management Tools
caveats: Download up to 8K, private video, channel/playlist/account download, subtitles and cropping require a paid license ($9.99 for 1 device or $15 for 2 devices)
Mobile apps are not available yet; the page says they are planned for the future
Merge subtitle to video is marked coming soon and Youku subtitle support is coming soon
